verdict.rationale: Meltano ships a well-documented, first-class CLI (meltano init, add, config, run) that is the primary interface for managing projects and pipelines, confirmed by both official docs and community descriptions of it as 'CLI-first'. Missing for 10: no evidence of AI-agent-specific CLI features (e.g., structured/JSON output for agent consumption) or independent hands-on validation of the CLI in agentic workflows.
